text: In 2019, the Chicago artist Anthony McCoy looks for inspiration in the Cabrini-Green projects, where a laundromat owner tells him of Sherman Fields, a man with a hook for a hand [beaten to death by police and later proven innocent|wrong|the outsider punished]. Legend says that [whoever says Candyman five times into a mirror|rules|calling it brings it] will be killed by his spirit. Anthony [turns the story into an art piece|who_suffers|meddlers and creators], and as people around his show begin to die, [a bee sting on his hand|images|vermin and creeping things] starts to spread across his body.
